## 🚀 What's New in v0.8.8 - **Agent Management API (beta):** Create, discover, update, and delete Agents; manage Agent files and Skills; and authenticate machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities while preserving existing role and Agent access controls. Public OpenAPI and Swagger UI cover inference, events, Agent management, and Skill management. - **Attached workspaces (highly experimental):** Select or save a per-Agent default workspace for each managed or personal code worker, then let Agents inspect trees, read and search files, author changes, and run Bash with bounded timeouts.
